M9-02-SYNERGIES.5:
Model the impact of synergies over the first three years after closing.

- **Run-rate cost synergies**: {p0} a year
- **Phasing**: {p1} of run-rate in years 1, 2 and 3
- **One-off integration costs**: {p2}
- **Tax rate**: {p3}

The synergies announced to the market are the run-rate ones; in the first years only part of them arrives, while the costs of getting them (staff exits, site closures, systems) are paid straight away. It's normal for the net impact to be negative in the first year: the committee needs to see it.

Build the three rows, one formula per row copied across the three years.
M9-02-SYNERGIES.20: Row {row}: {cosa}. One formula in B{row}, copied across to D{row}.
M9-02-SYNERGIES.title: M&A synergies: phasing curve, integration costs and net impact
